name: giftmarshal-integration-tests
description: Drives the real triggers and callables against the emulator suite.

scripts.pretest: npm --prefix ../core-port run build && npm --prefix ../functions run build
scripts.test: cd .. && firebase --config firebase.emulators.json emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-giftmarshal "node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=120000 integration-tests/*.test.mjs"
